case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

You asked for a binding volume and a clear basis for the coming term. All three of our options give your committee exactly that: a binding annual volume over a contract term twice as long as the one you proposed, so Selvbrunn can plan its copper and labour costs with certainty.

Our forecast for Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 rises 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).

On our order history:
Our orders of Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 with you were placed at EUR 414.61 on 2024-10-14 (po:4500011548-10), EUR 400.19 on 2025-06-30 (po:4500012634-10), EUR 412.74 on 2026-01-27 (po:4500013491-10) and EUR 412.74 on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014465-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 418.79; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 416.33; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 415.11; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Binding volume in every option: 4,580 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve, because it commits us to the full volume for the whole term while the price stays close to what we have paid so far. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Please take Option A to the committee, and tell us if it needs anything further from us to decide.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the price history and volume change data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We have reviewed your proposals and acknowledge the verified volume forecast and the 24-month contract term. While we appreciate the extended commitment, a 90-day payment term is not feasible for us. Therefore, we build on your Option C, offering EUR 429.43 per unit with a 45-day payment term. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot consists of a price of €431.63 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, we offer a price of €429.43 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Legal Department: Please note that our general terms and conditions apply to this process; furthermore, the quote lists our standard terms.

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

You asked which volume we can commit to, and you said a binding higher volume would help you. Option B raises that volume further.

Thank you for taking the price history and the volume forecast into account. We understand that price reductions are frozen, so we have built the options around the terms you said you can discuss: volume, contract length and payment.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 84.6% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70530@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 420.71; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 413.18; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 5,496 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 418.24; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Binding volume in every option: 4,580 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

For your pricing committee, in plain words: Option A gives Selvbrunn a binding annual volume for two full years, a fixed unit price and a clear basis for planning its copper and labour costs. We would ask you to take Option A to the committee. If it needs anything further to approve it, tell us and we will provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
